# CAIBIrnaseq

**CAIBIrnaseq** is an R package for streamlining, standardizing, and reproducing key steps of RNA-seq gene expression analysis. Developed by the **CAIBI platform team**, it covers the full workflow from raw counts to biological interpretation:

- **Preprocessing** raw expression data (TPM calculation, filtering, normalization, etc.)
- **Exploratory data analysis** (PCA, clustering, heatmaps)
- **Differential expression analysis** (DESeq2 or limma-voom, with visualization of DE genes)
- **Functional and pathway analysis** (FGSEA, ORA, PROGENy scoring)
- **Tumor microenvironment investigation** (MCPcounter, cell-type signatures)

Whether you're running a supervised or unsupervised RNA-seq analysis, CAIBIrnaseq provides robust, reusable methods for interpreting gene expression data.

## Installation

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# If not already installed
install.packages("remotes")

# Install from GitHub
remotes::install_github("crcordeliers/CAIBIrnaseq", dependencies = TRUE)
```

## Getting started

The package website has the full function reference and worked examples for both supervised and unsupervised RNA-seq analysis:
<https://crcordeliers.github.io/CAIBIrnaseq/>

If you run into any issues, please [open an issue](https://github.com/crcordeliers/CAIBIrnaseq/issues) on GitHub.
